+"""
+Loads image bytes from a reference that a user may have set (cut image_path,
+character image URL, style reference, ...).
+
+The backend never makes an HTTP request for such a reference: an arbitrary
+URL could point inside our network (SSRF). Only these are accepted:
+
+- ``data:image/...;base64,...`` URLs, decoded in memory;
+- relative storage paths (``cuts/<id>/<uuid>.png``);
+- full URLs under ``settings.STORAGE_HOST``, which are mapped back to their
+  relative storage path.
+
+Storage objects are read through the storage client, not over HTTP.
+Anything else is refused and returns ``None``.
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+import logging
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def storage_key_for(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return the storage object key for `ref`, or None if `ref` is not a
+    reference to our storage."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if host and ref.startswith(host + "/"):
+        key = ref[len(host) + 1:]
+        # Drop query string / fragment (e.g. cache busters).
+        key = urlsplit(key).path
+        key = unquote(key)
+    elif "://" in ref or ref.startswith("//") or ":" in ref.split("/", 1)[0]:
+        # Some other absolute URL (any scheme) - not our storage.
+        return None
+    else:
+        key = ref
+    key = key.lstrip("/")
+    if not key or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Return the bytes of the image `ref` points to, or None if it cannot or
+    must not be loaded. Never issues a network request to a user-given URL."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    if ref.startswith("data:"):
+        if not ref.startswith("data:image"):
+            return None
+        try:
+            _, encoded = ref.split(",", 1)
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+        except (ValueError, binascii.Error):
+            return None
+
+    key = storage_key_for(ref)
+    if key is None:
+        logger.warning("Refusing to load image from a URL outside storage: %.100s", ref)
+        return None
+
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    try:
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception as e:  # storage errors must not break callers
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image from storage: %s", e)
+        return None

+"""Exports report the cuts they leave out: `missing.txt` in the ZIP and the
+`X-Missing-Cuts` header on both formats."""
+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG, FakeMinio
+
+
+def _store(key: str, data: bytes = PNG):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+
+    FakeMinio.objects.setdefault(settings.MINIO_BUCKET, {})[key] = data
+
+
+def _episode(client, h, image_paths):
+    """Creates an episode with one cut per entry (cut numbers 1..n)."""
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    ep = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 1}
+    )
+    assert ep.status_code == 200, ep.text
+    episode_id = ep.json()["id"]
+    for n, path in enumerate(image_paths, start=1):
+        r = client.post(
+            "/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": n, "image_path": path}
+        )
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode_id
+
+
+def _export(client, h, episode_id, fmt):
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r
+
+
+MIXED = [
+    "cuts/ok/1.png",                          # 1: loads
+    None,                                     # 2: no image yet
+    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",  # 3: refused address
+    "cuts/ok/does-not-exist.png",             # 4: cannot be loaded
+    "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode(),  # 5: loads
+]
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_missing_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _store("cuts/ok/1.png")
+    r = _export(client, h, _episode(client, h, MIXED), "zip")
+
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+    zf = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content))
+    assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode().splitlines() == ["2", "3", "4"]
+    assert sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith(".png")) == ["Ep_1_01.png", "Ep_1_05.png"]
+
+
+def test_webtoon_header_lists_missing_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _store("cuts/ok/1.png")
+    r = _export(client, h, _episode(client, h, MIXED), "webtoon")
+
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+    assert r.content[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
+
+
+def test_webtoon_counts_undecodable_image_as_missing(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _store("cuts/ok/1.png")
+    _store("cuts/ok/broken.png", b"not an image")
+    r = _export(client, h, _episode(client, h, ["cuts/ok/1.png", "cuts/ok/broken.png"]), "webtoon")
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2"
+
+
+def test_nothing_missing_means_no_file_and_no_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _store("cuts/ok/1.png")
+    _store("cuts/ok/2.png")
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, ["cuts/ok/1.png", "cuts/ok/2.png"])
+
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+    assert "missing.txt" not in zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)).namelist()
+
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "webtoon")
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+
+
+def test_missing_cuts_header_is_exposed_to_browsers(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _store("cuts/ok/1.png")
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, ["cuts/ok/1.png", None])
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers={**h, "Origin": "http://localhost:3000"}
+    )
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2"
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" in r.headers["Access-Control-Expose-Headers"].lower()
